_comment: Case pack for CASE 002 / OPERATION LOOKBOOK. Same schema as case-001-maya.json so the engine can swap creators by changing one filename. Transcribed from docs/evidence/case-002-operation-lookbook.txt.

case.logline: A 50K creator. A highly trusted audience. A business increasingly bottlenecked by her own judgement.
case.mission: Turn Sofia's taste into something her audience can actually use — without turning her into a catalogue.
case.ask: Build one working product that uses Sofia's judgement to help ONE real audience member make ONE better decision.
judged_on: Value to a real audience member
case.final_line_template: Sofia no longer needs to ____ because ____.
ground_rules: You do not need AI or expensive model calls.
Use the evidence. Ignore the theatre.
A simple product that works beats a complicated demo.
case.objective: ONE PRODUCT. ONE AUDIENCE MEMBER. ONE DECISION MADE BETTER. If you cannot name the person and the decision, you do not have a product yet.

creator.name: Sofia Bennett
creator.business: Affiliate + brand + UGC; also paid styling and creator-led edits
creator.reputation: Sofia has an audience that treats her like their best-dressed friend. They believe she can save them from bad purchases and bad styling decisions.
creator.assessment: Her taste is the asset. The value of her judgement is still trapped inside the creator.
creator.what_she_wants: More audience intimacy, not less. Less repetitive admin, more time spent making content and finding great products.
creator.what_people_want: Not another list of links. They want Sofia to decide: what would I buy, what would I wear, what is worth it, and what fits my life?

voice.voice_note: I actually like answering people. It is why the community feels like a community. I just don't want my business model to require me to be awake every time someone wants my opinion. If something could capture how I think about clothes — not just what I own — that would be useful.
voice.her_rule: I would rather link 3 things I truly love than 30 things I was paid to post.
voice.creed: People want my eye, not my inventory.
style_rules: If I wouldn't text this to my sister, I don't link it.
Buy once, wear forever — she rates longevity over novelty.
She will name the cheaper version as 'enough' when it is (the £35 white tee).
She will flag a great item as wrong for you (the vintage leather is 'great, but warm').

unfinished_ideas: let people tell me what they already own
maybe the answer is not a shop

shelf_assessment: The dataset intentionally mixes objective facts with Sofia's subjective judgement. The subjective layer is not noise. It is the product. Extract shown: 8 of 36 items.

personas.name: The Recreator
personas.says: How do I get this vibe?
personas.needs: The look, not necessarily the exact item.

personas.name: The Value Hunter
personas.needs: The same taste at a lower price.

personas.name: The Stylist
personas.says: What would you wear with this?
personas.needs: Styling around what they already own.

personas.name: The Friend
personas.needs: Shares with someone else who might buy. Often invisible to last-click.

personas_note: The audience does not behave like one audience.

tracked_individuals.name: Clara
tracked_individuals.profile: Wants a look for less. Views 6 times, saves, then searches herself.

tracked_individuals.name: Jamie
tracked_individuals.profile: Owns basics. Wants styling help. Returns to old posts and asks follow-ups.

tracked_individuals.name: Priya
tracked_individuals.profile: Wants Sofia's 'buy once' judgement. Saves 'worth it' posts.

tracked_individuals.name: Ella
tracked_individuals.profile: Sends outfits to friends. Friend often makes the purchase.

inbox_clue: Twelve messages, seven different jobs. Underneath all of them: decide for me the way you would decide for yourself.

broadcast_log.title: 3 outfits I'd wear to London Fashion Week
Things I would never buy again

broadcast_clue: 184K views produced 92 purchases. 28K views produced 427. Read the behaviour, not the vanity metric.

field_notes_tuesday.detail: Outfit details saved as voice notes
Friend sends her a look to recreate
Tomorrow I need to fix this.

field_notes_clue: Two DM sprints a day and the queue still grows. The bottleneck is not effort. It is that her judgement only exists in real time.

intelligence_drop_1600.headline: THE PURCHASE IS OFTEN NOT THE CLICK
intelligence_drop_1600.detail: People use Sofia to decide, then buy later, sometimes somewhere else. The value is being undercounted by the obvious metrics.

hidden_audience.look_closer: The YES/NO around link clicks is intentionally incomplete. You are supposed to decide what matters, then decide what to instrument. Signal can be behavioural, not transactional.

build_must: Help a real audience member make a better decision.
Preserve a meaningful piece of Sofia's judgement / taste.
Be demonstrable in a few clicks.
Not require expensive AI inference to be impressive.
things_you_do_not_need: A pitch deck pretending it is a product.
